title: Analogy
parentNote: Read the first pair together and ask "How are these two connected?" out loud before looking at the options — naming the connection is the whole trick.
learnBullets: Finding the **connection** (relationship) between a pair of things
Applying the **same connection** to a new pair
Common analogy types: baby-parent, part-whole, use/tool, category, opposite, number relation
learnItFirst:
**The Big Idea:** Analogy questions give you a matched PAIR, then ask you to complete a SECOND pair using the SAME connection.

```
🐄 is to 🐮  as  🐕 is to  ___
(Cow)  (Calf)     (Dog)
```
Connection: **animal → its baby**. A dog's baby is a puppy, so the answer is 🐕‍🦺 (puppy)!

**Common connections to look for:**
| Connection type | Example |
|---|---|
| Animal → baby | Cow → Calf, Dog → Puppy |
| Part → whole | Wheel → Car, Page → Book |
| Tool → user | Pen → Writer, Needle → Tailor |
| Object → group | Apple → Fruit, Car → Vehicle |
| Opposite | Hot → Cold, Big → Small |
| Number pattern | 2 → 4 (double), 5 → 10 (double) |

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Name** the connection between the first pair in a full sentence: "A ___ is the baby of a ___."
2. **Use that exact sentence** with the new first word.
3. **Pick** the option that completes the sentence correctly.

---

questions.content: 🐄 is to 🐮 (calf) as 🐕 is to ___
questions.why: A dog's baby is called a puppy

questions.content: 🐱 is to 🐈 (kitten) as 🐔 is to ___
questions.why: A hen's baby is called a chick

questions.content: Hot is to Cold as Big is to ___
questions.why: Big and Small are opposites, just like Hot and Cold

questions.content: Day is to Sun as Night is to ___
questions.why: The Sun is seen in the day; the Moon is seen at night

questions.content: Up is to Down as Left is to ___
questions.why: Up-Down and Left-Right are opposite direction pairs

questions.content: 🐟 is to Water as 🐦 is to ___
questions.why: A fish lives in water; a bird lives/flies in the air

questions.content: Pen is to Writing as Knife is to ___
questions.why: A pen is used for writing; a knife is used for cutting

questions.content: 2 is to 4 as 3 is to ___  *(hint: double the number)*
questions.why: The rule is "double the number": 2→4, so 3→6

questions.content: Book is to Reading as Bed is to ___
questions.why: A book is used for reading; a bed is used for sleeping

questions.content: Apple is to Fruit as Carrot is to ___
questions.why: An apple belongs to the fruit group; a carrot belongs to the vegetable group

questions.content: Wheel is to Car as Page is to ___
questions.why: A wheel is a part of a car; a page is a part of a book

questions.content: Finger is to Hand as Toe is to ___
questions.why: Fingers are on the hand; toes are on the foot

questions.content: Teacher is to School as Doctor is to ___
questions.why: A teacher works at a school; a doctor works at a hospital

questions.content: 5 is to 10 as 6 is to ___  *(hint: double the number)*
questions.why: The rule is "double the number": 5→10, so 6→12

questions.content: Cow is to Milk as Hen is to ___
questions.why: A cow gives milk; a hen gives eggs

questions.content: Bee is to Honey as Spider is to ___
questions.why: A bee makes honey; a spider makes a web

questions.content: Umbrella is to Rain as Sweater is to ___
questions.why: An umbrella protects from rain; a sweater protects from cold

questions.content: Eye is to Seeing as Ear is to ___
questions.why: Eyes are used for seeing; ears are used for hearing

questions.content: Tailor is to Needle as Carpenter is to ___
questions.why: A tailor uses a needle; a carpenter uses a hammer

questions.content: 10 is to 5 as 20 is to ___
questions.why: The rule is "divide by 2": 10→5, so 20→10

questions.content: Fish is to Fin as Bird is to ___
questions.why: A fish uses fins to swim; a bird uses wings to fly

questions.content: Chef is to Kitchen as Farmer is to ___
questions.why: A chef works in a kitchen; a farmer works in a field

questions.content: Square is to 4 sides as Triangle is to ___
questions.why: A square has 4 sides; a triangle has 3 sides

questions.content: Petrol is to Car as Food is to ___
questions.why: Petrol gives energy to a car; food gives energy to a human

questions.content: 1 is to 3 as 2 is to ___  *(hint: multiply by 3)*
questions.why: The rule is "multiply by 3": 1→3, so 2→6

questions.content: Caterpillar is to Butterfly as Tadpole is to ___
questions.why: A caterpillar grows into a butterfly; a tadpole grows into a frog

questions.content: Thermometer is to Temperature as Weighing Scale is to ___
questions.why: A thermometer measures temperature; a weighing scale measures weight

questions.content: 3 is to 9 as 4 is to ___  *(hint: multiply the number by itself!)*
questions.why: The rule is "multiply the number by itself": 3×3=9, so 4×4=16

questions.content: Triangle is to 3 corners as Pentagon is to ___
questions.why: A triangle has 3 corners; a pentagon has 5 corners

questions.content: Morning is to Breakfast as Night is to ___
questions.why: Breakfast is eaten in the morning; dinner is eaten at night
